_comment: Retirement Crossword clue-generation. varietyAngles rotate by seed so two users on the same theme get different word sets.

locale.nativeLine: - Write in clear English for adults and retirees.

difficultyLine: Difficulty '{difficulty}': easy/relaxed = the plainest everyday word that fits, with a direct definition clue; medium/classic = everyday words with clear descriptive clues; hard/challenge = fuller vocabulary with fair, slightly indirect clues — never obscure trivia, wordplay or cryptic constructions. Answer length is set by the minLetters/maxLetters range above, not by difficulty.
